title: 第24章 迷雾第25章 周雪的意
lines: 斩仙刀出现的一刻周雪便感觉到了，她没有多想为什么，也没有时间去想，秋梧刚才死去的场景好像浮现在她眼前
她心中涌起一股愤怒，斩仙刀弹开背后的黑袍人随即出现在她手中
一股淡红色的光晕缠绕在斩仙刀上，周雪愤怒一斩，斩仙刀划出一道淡红色刀影瞬间将尽数黑袍拦腰斩断，整个街道都被斩出一道缺口
“没事吧”一道声音在周雪背后响起，正是周岐
周雪看着周岐失声痛哭
“秋大哥他死了，为了救我就死在我面前…”望着双眼赤红潸然泪下的周雪周岐并没有出声安慰
“你可以救他的，只是你没有”
周雪一脸不解，她擦了擦眼泪
“我不知道斩仙刀在我身体里，要是知道…”
“就算知道你也救不了他，这里只有意才可以动用，你刚才是因为看见他被杀了，心中充满愤怒的杀意，这才催动了斩仙刀”
“如果你提前知道，你能动用它吗，还是会躲在他的背后”
“所以，你知道我们会遇到危险”周雪突然收起悲意紧紧盯着周岐，眼中泪水还在打转
“没错，这是交给你的第三课，万事只能靠自己，如果什么都靠别人，去依赖别人，那么你只能是一个花瓶”
“害死秋梧的不是我，而是你，如果你够强，如果你想的是拼死也要拉个垫背的，有这种心境，那他，就不会死”
周岐的话深深印在周雪的脑海里，她突然觉得眼前的周岐好冷血，让人害怕，望着远处无头身躯的秋梧，她呆在了原地
周岐走到秋梧的身旁，手轻一拂收起了他的尸体，随即向皇城某处走去
“跟上，从今天开始除非生死危机，我不会出手保护你”周雪闻言起身，眼中多了一丝倔强跟坚毅，连忙跟上
秋家，皇朝三大世家之一，同时也是位朝中丞相府，坐落于皇宫城门左侧，占地广阔，气势恢宏
府邸四周高墙环绕，大门由厚重的红木所造，门两侧各有一尊石狮，门楣上悬挂着一块巨大的匾额，刻着“秋府”二字
门外站着两名侍卫，见到周岐二人立马出声厉喝
“此乃丞相府，来人止步！”
周岐停下，平静的声音传出
“我来见你们家老爷，就说秋梧的事”
两名侍卫听到秋梧立马神色一松，其中一人向周岐打听道
“梧哥怎么了？”
见周岐没有回应，其中一人露出尴尬之色也是连忙进去禀告
片刻之后他便出来做出一个请的手势，周岐二人跟着进来，里面很是华丽，四处悬挂着字画，假山流水，毛毯铺地，气派十分
走到一处庭院门口侍卫停下，二人便走了进去，里面有一张石桌，桌旁有一名身着深紫色官袍，头戴乌纱帽老者
老者面容端正，眼神锐利，他看向周岐，不禁感叹道:“这位小友真是气宇非凡，英雄出少年啊！”
老者浑厚的声音传来，气势十足，周岐顺势坐下，周雪就这样站在身旁
见周岐没有回应，老者也不恼，天骄自有傲气，随即他神色一正询问道:“听闻小友找我是秋梧的事，不知是发生了什么？”
周岐手中一拂，秋梧连同他的头颅出现在庭院之中，老者刚开始瞳孔深深一缩，随即眼中也是露出悲伤神色
“不知是发生了什么”
这次轮到周雪上前述说，说完她也是再次看向秋梧的尸体
“秋大哥也是为了我才…”周雪语气中带着愧疚，老者连忙摇头道:“终究是牵连了姑娘，可惜什么线索都没有”
content_en:
Zhou Xue felt it the moment the Immortal Killing Sword appeared. She didn't think much about why, and she didn't have time to think about it. The scene where Qiu Wu died just now seemed to appear in front of her eyes.
There was a surge of anger in her heart, and the man in black robes behind her immediately appeared in her hand.
A light red halo wrapped around the Immortal Killing Sword. Zhou Xue slashed angrily. The Immortal Killing Sword drew a light red blade and instantly cut off all the black robes. A gap was cut in the entire street.
"Are you okay?" A voice sounded behind Zhou Xue, it was Zhou Qi
Zhou Xue looked at Zhou Qi and cried bitterly
"Brother Qiu is dead. He died in front of me to save me..." Looking at Zhou Xue and Zhou Qi who had red eyes and tears streaming down his face, he did not say anything to comfort him.
"You could have saved him, but you didn't."
Zhou Xue looked puzzled and wiped her tears
"I didn't know that the Immortal Killing Sword was in my body. If I knew..."
"Even if you know that you can't save him, only intention can be used here. You just saw him being killed, and your heart was full of angry killing intent, so you activated the Immortal Sword."
"If you knew in advance, would you be able to use it, or would you still hide behind him?"
"So, you know we will be in danger." Zhou Xue suddenly put away her sadness and stared at Zhou Qi closely, tears still rolling in her eyes.
"Yes, this is the third lesson for you. You can only rely on yourself for everything. If you rely on others for everything, then you can only be a vase."
"It was not me who killed Qiu Wu, but you. If you are strong enough, if you want to be supported even if you risk your life, and you have this kind of mentality, then he will not die."
Zhou Qi's words were deeply imprinted in Zhou Xue's mind. She suddenly felt that Zhou Qi in front of her was so cold-blooded and scary. Looking at Qiu Wu's headless body in the distance, she stayed where she was.
Zhou Qi walked to Qiu Wu's side, put away his body with a flick of his hand, and then walked somewhere in the imperial city.
"Follow me. From today on, unless there is a life or death crisis, I will not protect you." Zhou Xue stood up after hearing this, with a hint of stubbornness and perseverance in her eyes, and she quickly followed.
The Qiu family, one of the three great families in the dynasty, is also the residence of the prime minister. It is located on the left side of the palace gate. It occupies a vast area and is magnificent.
The mansion is surrounded by high walls. The gate is made of thick mahogany. There are stone lions on both sides of the gate. A huge plaque hangs on the lintel with the word "Autumn Mansion" engraved on it.
Two guards stood outside the door. When they saw Zhou Qi and the others, they immediately shouted loudly.
"This is the Prime Minister's Mansion, stop anyone coming!"
Zhou Qi stopped and a calm voice came out
"I came to see your master to talk about Qiu Wu."
The two guards immediately relaxed when they heard Qiu Wu, and one of them asked Zhou Qi
"What's wrong, Brother Wu?"
Seeing that Zhou Qi didn't respond, one of them looked embarrassed and quickly went in to report.
After a while, he came out and made an invitation gesture, and Zhou Qi and the others followed in. It was very gorgeous inside, with calligraphy and paintings hanging everywhere, rockeries and flowing water, and blankets on the floor. It was very grand.
The guard stopped at the entrance of a courtyard, and the two of them walked in. There was a stone table inside, and beside the table was an old man wearing a dark purple official robe and a black gauze hat.
The old man had a straight face and sharp eyes. He looked at Zhou Qi and couldn't help but sigh: "This little friend is really extraordinary. A hero comes from a young boy!"
The old man's rich voice came, full of momentum. Zhou Qi sat down and Zhou Xue stood beside him.
Seeing that Zhou Qi didn't respond, the old man wasn't annoyed either. Tianjiao has his own arrogance. Then he looked straight and asked: "I heard that my little friend came to me because of Qiu Wu. I wonder what happened?"
Zhou Qi flicked his hand, and Qiu Wu and his head appeared in the courtyard. At first, the old man's pupils shrank deeply, and then a sad look appeared in his eyes.
“I don’t know what happened”
This time it was Zhou Xue's turn to speak up. After saying this, she looked at Qiu Wu's body again.
"Brother Qiu did it for me..." Zhou Xue said with guilt in her tone. The old man shook his head quickly and said: "After all, the girl was implicated, but it's a pity that there are no clues."
title_en: Chapter 24 Mist Chapter 25 Zhou Xue’s intention
